events.speaker: LOUISA
events.text: A post that never existed, a trunk of books that did. Somebody around here must want to learn something.

events.speaker: LOUISA
events.text: He read it out loud, badly, and finished. That is a better lesson than most I taught back east.

events.speaker: LOUISA
events.text: A place, and someone who'll actually sit still for it. I'll take that over the post I lost.

events.speaker: LOUISA
events.text: You corrected my grammar back at me once, badly, on purpose. I've thought about it more than I should.
